data.description: Two ways up, one compact frame. The Net Rock Climber is an A-frame with a green rock wall on one face and a rope net on the other. Children pick the route that suits their confidence. The rock wall asks for careful foot placement on fixed holds, while the net moves under their weight and tests balance. Many children go up one side and down the other. Its footprint is only 5'3" x 4'7", with a safe play area of 10'3" x 9'7", which makes it a good fit for a society garden with limited space. The frame is finished in Lavender. Our warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipe, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site photos and we will suggest where it goes.

props.pText: The A-frame is galvanised pipe, the climbing net is play rope and the rock face carries fixed holds. All of these sit under our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Check the net for wear and the holds for tightness as part of regular maintenance, and keep a soft surface on both sides of the frame.
